title: Multi-module GRPO: Composing Policy Gradients and Prompt Optimization for Language Model Programs
problem: Modular language-model programs cannot directly exploit single-module GRPO for system-level improvement.
assumption_broken: Policy-gradient optimization need not treat a multi-call language-model program as a single undifferentiated policy.
operational_signature: Roll out → group by component → update policies → refine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: mmGRPO groups calls by module across rollouts while handling variable-length and interrupted trajectories, and composes these updates with prompt optimization.

title: Navigating Cognitive Manifolds: Optimal Transport for Large Language Model Optimization
problem: Task-specific knowledge organization and activation are inefficient under trial-and-error prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization can be treated as geometric navigation rather than empirical text editing.
operational_signature: Represent configurations → measure distance → follow directional guidance → optimize
load_bearing_mechanism: Wasserstein distances and Kantorovich potential gradients jointly guide optimization between cognitive configurations.

title: TN-AutoRCA: Benchmark Construction and Agentic Framework for Self-Improving Alarm-Based Root Cause Analysis in Telecommunication Networks
problem: Telecommunication alarm root cause analysis suffers from difficult graph reasoning and systemic errors in generated analysis code.
assumption_broken: Repairing isolated failures is not sufficient when failures share underlying logical flaws.
operational_signature: Evaluate → aggregate failures → contrast patterns → repair logic
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrastive feedback across all failure cases guides code repairs toward common systemic logical flaws.

title: Prompting to Prompt: Meta-Template Learning for Transferable Prompt Optimization
problem: Prompt optimization transfers poorly and relies heavily on task-specific data.
assumption_broken: Prompt structure and selection strategies can be learned across tasks instead of optimized only for each task.
operational_signature: Refine elements → compare changes → update reusable structure → generate instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: A bi-level loop extracts transferable structural knowledge from element-level inner-loop changes and updates meta-template structures and selection strategies.

improver_modified.how: The outer loop updates the meta-template structures and selection strategies used to generate and refine prompts.

title: RobustFlow: Towards Robust Agentic Workflow Generation
problem: Generated agentic workflows are inconsistent under semantically equivalent instruction variations.
assumption_broken: Workflow generation need not remain sensitive to surface phrasing of equivalent task descriptions.
operational_signature: Vary instructions → compare structures → optimize preferences → generate consistently
load_bearing_mechanism: Preference optimization on synonymous task descriptions trains workflow generators to be invariant to instruction variations.

title: Self-Tooling Agent: Dynamically Extending Agent Capabilities through Scientific Tool Synthesis and Invocation
problem: Agents lack expert scientific tools, while manually curated toolsets are expensive and fail to generalize.
assumption_broken: An agent can synthesize needed tools at runtime instead of being constrained to a fixed toolset.
operational_signature: Identify need → synthesize or invoke → execute → register
load_bearing_mechanism: A policy trained with supervised fine-tuning and reward-based reinforcement learning arbitrates between existing-tool invocation and new-tool synthesis in an interactive sandbox.

improver_modified.how: Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning train the policy that chooses tool invocation versus synthesis.

title: MR.PEA: The Meta-Reasoning Prompt Engineering Agent
problem: Prompt optimization depends on costly labels or suffers ambiguous and expensive self-supervised feedback.
assumption_broken: Useful validation examples and evaluation criteria can be constructed from minimal input rather than supplied as labeled datasets.
operational_signature: Build knowledge → retrieve information → generate validation examples → refine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Iteratively accumulated task strategies and evaluation criteria guide synthetic validation, targeted prompt refinement, and quality assessment.

title: A Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents via Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning
problem: Current agents lack persistent memory and self-motivated adaptation over long, evolving experiences.
assumption_broken: Agent evaluation should test proactive lifelong learning rather than only static externally prompted tasks.
operational_signature: Experience changes → retain knowledge → set goals → act
load_bearing_mechanism: StuLife simulates a multi-phase college journey with evolving resources and metrics assessing persistent memory, skill acquisition, and self-initiated behavior.
limitations_evident: Evaluated models show fundamental deficiencies in long-term memory and self-motivated initiative.

title: Decomposing Prompts: Discovering Reusable Scaffolds and Task-Specific Residuals
problem: Monolithic prompt optimization requires expensive reoptimization and prevents reuse across related tasks.
assumption_broken: Prompts can be decomposed into reusable domain-invariant structure and task-specific adaptations.
operational_signature: Decompose → discover shared structure → reuse → adapt residual
load_bearing_mechanism: An MDL-inspired two-stage algorithm discovers reusable instructional scaffolds and concise task-specific residuals.

title: PRL: Prompts from Reinforcement Learning
problem: Effective prompt generation requires expert intuition and subtle semantic cues that humans may overlook.
assumption_broken: Useful few-shot examples need not be limited to examples observed during training.
operational_signature: Train generator → synthesize examples → construct instructions → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: Reinforcement learning trains automatic prompt generation that can synthesize novel few-shot examples.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning trains the prompt-generating policy.

title: Automating Environments For Measuring Agentic Learning
problem: Cross-environment agent learning lacks controllable heterogeneous benchmarks and a unified representation of learning methods.
assumption_broken: A fixed environment distribution and a single learning method are insufficient for heterogeneous environments.
operational_signature: Generate environments → select method → optimize component → evaluate adaptation
load_bearing_mechanism: AutoEnv factorizes environment transitions, observations, and rewards and supports component-centric comparison and adaptive selection of learning methods.
limitations_evident: Single-method gains decrease as the number of environments increases.
Adaptive method selection has diminishing returns as the method space expands.

title: OMAC: A Broad Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
problem: Multi-agent systems rely on handcrafted designs and lack systematic holistic optimization.
assumption_broken: Agent functionality and collaboration structure can be jointly optimized rather than manually fixed.
operational_signature: Initialize semantics → compare alternatives → optimize dimension → jointly optimize
load_bearing_mechanism: A Semantic Initializer and Contrastive Comparator optimize individual dimensions before joint optimization across agent functionality and collaboration structure.

title: ENCOURAGING CRITICAL THINKING FOR MULTIAGENT DEBATE
problem: Repeated self-improvement with homogeneous reasoning yields diminishing returns and limited perspective diversity.
assumption_broken: Debating agents need not share identical prompts or reasoning strategies.
operational_signature: Generate specialized instructions → assess diversity and effectiveness → select strategies → fine-tune generator
load_bearing_mechanism: A strategy generator is iteratively fine-tuned on selected diverse and effective strategies to specialize agents while preserving varied reasoning paths.

improver_modified.how: The strategy generator is iteratively fine-tuned using selected diverse and effective strategies.

title: Growing with Your Embodied Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Lifelong Code Generation Framework for Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
problem: Long-horizon manipulation code fails under ambiguous instructions, limited context, and poor retention of corrected knowledge.
assumption_broken: Human corrections can become extensible reusable skills rather than transient fixes.
operational_signature: Generate code → obtain feedback → encode skills → retrieve and extend
load_bearing_mechanism: Human feedback is encoded into reusable extensible skills stored in external memory and retrieved with hints for later code generation.

title: Dynamic Target Attack
problem: Fixed affirmative optimization targets are improbable under aligned models and make adversarial prompt optimization costly.
assumption_broken: The desired response target can change during optimization rather than remain a fixed affirmative prefix.
operational_signature: Sample responses → select target → optimize input → resample
load_bearing_mechanism: Using the model's own sampled responses as changing optimization targets reduces mismatch between targets and the current output distribution.

title: Enhancing Reasoning Chains through GANs and Textual Gradient Feedback
problem: Multi-agent reasoning improvements neglect stability and the training value of adversarial erroneous reasoning chains.
assumption_broken: Backward generation of erroneous reasoning can improve forward reasoning rather than merely degrade it.
operational_signature: Generate valid chains → generate erroneous chains → discriminate → refine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: A discriminator supplies textual gradients to competitively refine forward and backward generators in an adversarial loop.

title: Reward-guided Meta-Prompt Evolving with Reflection for LLM Jailbreaking
problem: Black-box jailbreak generation depends on human prompt expertise or intricate automated workflows.
assumption_broken: The reusable meta-prompt that generates attacks can itself be improved from outcomes and reflections.
operational_signature: Generate attempts → judge outcomes → reflect on strategies → update generator instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Reward-scored reflection strategies from successful and failed attempts optimize the meta-prompt used to generate subsequent attacks.

improver_modified.how: The meta-prompt governing attack generation is updated using reward-selected reflection strategies.

title: Evolving and Detecting Multi-Turn Deception using Geometric Signatures
problem: Single-turn safety evaluation misses indirect multi-turn deception and lightweight ways to detect it.
assumption_broken: Multi-turn deceptive intent can be identified through stable embedding geometry rather than expensive end-to-end modeling.
operational_signature: Evolve conversations → validate deception → extract geometry → classify intent
load_bearing_mechanism: Multi-objective genetic prompt optimization with co-evolving mutation operators supplies deceptive conversations for a compact geometric-feature detector.

improver_modified.how: Mutation operators co-evolve during the genetic prompt optimization process.

limitations_evident: Early generations yielded the most convincing deception.
Adherence filtering and ordering effects constrain data generation.
Larger and more diverse human-evaluated datasets remain needed.

title: LLM-FE: Automated Feature Engineering for Tabular Data with LLMs as Evolutionary Optimizers
problem: Feature engineering is constrained by fixed transformations or fails to exploit reasoning about prior feature-discovery experiments.
assumption_broken: Feature transformations can be searched as programs rather than restricted to a manually defined transformation space.
operational_signature: Propose transformations → execute programs → evaluate prediction → evolve candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-based evolutionary program search combines domain knowledge with data-driven feedback to discover effective feature transformations.

title: ProRefine: Inference-time Prompt Refinement with Textual Feedback
problem: Small prompt defects compound across agentic reasoning workflows and reduce reliability.
assumption_broken: Prompts can be improved dynamically at inference time without retraining or ground-truth labels.
operational_signature: Attempt reasoning → generate feedback → revise instructions → reason again
load_bearing_mechanism: An LLM agentic loop generates and applies textual feedback to refine reasoning prompts during inference.

title: DELM: a Python toolkit for Data Extraction with Language Models
problem: Ad hoc LLM data-extraction scripts hinder reproducibility, robust execution, and systematic pipeline comparison.
assumption_broken: Extraction pipelines can be modular and systematically evaluated instead of implemented as isolated scripts.
operational_signature: Configure pipeline → extract structured data → validate and score → compare trade-offs
load_bearing_mechanism: A modular toolkit combines structured outputs, validation, configurable scoring, caching, and cost tracking to support rapid pipeline iteration.

title: Schema for In-Context Learning
problem: Example-driven in-context learning lacks explicit abstract knowledge retrieval and transfer.
assumption_broken: Models do not reliably infer reusable reasoning schemas implicitly from demonstrations.
operational_signature: Extract steps → abstract relationships → construct scaffold → apply to new query
load_bearing_mechanism: Explicit lightweight schemas capture key inferential steps and relationships from demonstrations and scaffold reasoning on novel questions.
limitations_evident: Reported gains depend on a high-quality single demonstration.

title: LLM Program Optimization via Retrieval Augmented Search
problem: Black-box LLM program optimization needs effective reuse of existing optimization examples and more interpretable edits.
assumption_broken: Retrieval based on source code need not be more useful than retrieval based on a generated natural-language description.
operational_signature: Describe candidate → retrieve examples → propose edits → retain search beam
load_bearing_mechanism: Beam search guided by examples retrieved using LLM-generated natural-language descriptions improves optimization, while AEGIS decomposes examples into atomic edits.

title: AlphaOPT: Formulating Optimization Programs with Self-Improving LLM Experience Library
problem: Mapping informal optimization problems into executable formulations remains brittle or requires costly retraining.
assumption_broken: Reusable optimization knowledge can improve through library updates rather than parameter updates or annotated reasoning traces.
operational_signature: Reflect on failures → verify insights → retrieve knowledge → refine applicability
load_bearing_mechanism: A two-phase experience-library cycle stores solver-verified structured insights and evolves their applicability conditions to correct retrieval misalignment.

improver_modified.how: Library evolution refines the applicability conditions governing which learned insights are retrieved for future formulation attempts.

title: All Life is Problem Creation: Learning to Generate Environments that Maximize Performance Gain
problem: Novelty- or difficulty-based curricula can generate unlearnable or irrelevant experiences instead of improving target-task performance.
assumption_broken: Training environments should maximize measured learning progress rather than proxy novelty or difficulty.
operational_signature: Probe learner → generate environments → train learner → measure gain
load_bearing_mechanism: A learned environment proposer conditioned on diagnostic probes of the solver targets environments that maximize target-task performance gain.

improver_modified.how: The environment proposer learns to generate curricula maximizing solver performance gain while conditioning on the evolving solver policy.

limitations_evident: Validation is limited to maze environments.

title: HexMachina: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Continual Learning of Catan
problem: Prompt-centric game agents saturate context and fail to sustain coherent long-horizon strategy in stochastic adversarial settings.
assumption_broken: LLMs can improve persistent executable players rather than reinterpret game state to choose every move.
operational_signature: Discover interface → compile player → evaluate play → evolve strategy
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating undocumented-environment discovery from compiled-player evolution preserves executable artifacts and reserves LLM reasoning for high-level strategy.
limitations_evident: Evaluation is confined to Catanatron experiments.

title: Beyond Visual cues: Harnessing Text signal for Test-Time OOD Detection
problem: Test-time OOD detection underuses textual adaptation and suffers from contaminated pseudo-labels.
assumption_broken: Adaptation can update textual semantic knowledge rather than only cache representative visual features.
operational_signature: Detect candidates → purify labels → update descriptions → retrieve knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Cluster-based pseudo-label purification supports continual OOD prompt updates and a retrievable textual knowledge bank from the test stream.

title: Memory-Driven Self-Improvement with Large Language Models
problem: General LLM prior knowledge is insufficient for data-limited task-specific sequential decision-making.
assumption_broken: A compact experience memory and the LLM prior can mutually improve rather than remain fixed independent resources.
operational_signature: Retain interactions → estimate values → refine prior → collect better trajectories
load_bearing_mechanism: Memory of past interactions and Q-values improves value estimation and LLM prior refinement, whose higher-reward trajectories further enrich memory.
